title: bug: keystore load uses open() without O_NOFOLLOW
description: wp11_keystore.c:875 opens the keystore file with open(path, O_RDONLY) -- no O_NOFOLLOW. A symlink at the keystore path is silently followed, potentially loading an attacker-supplied file instead of the intended keystore. The write path (line 1345) correctly uses O_NOFOLLOW with a comment explaining why; the read path was missed. Fix: change to open(path, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW). Add a comment matching the write path: 'O_NOFOLLOW: refuse to follow a symlink at the keystore path to prevent an attacker from redirecting the load to a crafted file.'
